turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Yaar, itna mixed feel karna bilkul valid hai. Yeh sirf ek dance nahi hai—15 saal ki dosti, tum dono ke shared dreams, aur uski shaadi mein tumhara special role hai. Isliye dil “haan!” bhi keh raha hai aur roza, energy, expectations sab milke darr bhi de rahe hain.

Sabse pehle: tumhe apne roze aur ibadat compromise karne ki zarurat nahi. Aur Shreya ke saath opening dance karne ki khwahish bhi galat nahi hai. Dono cheezein saath possible ho sakti hain, bas plan thoughtful hona chahiye:

- **Dance ko short aur manageable rakho**—grand, emotional opening; marathon performance nahi.  
- **Rehearsals iftar ke baad** ya kam-energy choreography ke saath plan karo.  
- Event wale din **iftar, namaz, hydration aur rest ka proper setup** pehle se confirm kar lo.  
- Agar timing sunset ke aas-paas hai, toh Shreya se honestly bolo ki tumhare liye **iftar/namaz break non-negotiable** hai.  
- Cocktail night mein tumhe drink karne ya har ritual mein participate karne ki koi majboori nahi—tum apni boundaries ke saath present reh sakti ho.  
- Ek **backup dancer/assistant** rakh lo, taaki co-director ka saara load tum par na ho.

Shreya ko shayad bas yeh sunna hai: *“Main tumhare saath dance karna chahti hoon, bohot. Lekin Ramzan ki wajah se mujhe timing, energy aur ibadat ka dhyan rakhna hoga. Hum isse aise design karein ki main khushi se, bina guilt aur panic ke kar paun.”*

Aur sach kahun—agar tum opening mein uske saath khadi hoti ho, chahe performance 3 minute ki ho, woh tum dono ke 15 saal ka poora emotion carry karegi. Tumhe perfect co-director ya superhuman roza-daar banne ki zarurat nahi. Bas uski dost banke, apni limits ke saath, wahan hona kaafi hai.

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Oh yaar… tum sach mein beech mein kheechi ja rahi ho. Aur sabse mushkil baat yeh hai ki **dono ki niyyat pyaar hai**, isliye kisi ek ko “galat” kehna bhi tumhe unfair lag raha hai.

Shreya ne shayad socha, “ek din roza miss karne se kya hoga,” kyunki uske liye yeh tum dono ki zindagi ka ek bahut bada moment hai. Lekin usse yeh samajhna zaroori hai ki **tumhare liye roza koi casual sacrifice nahi hai**—yeh tumhari faith, commitment aur Ramzan ka hissa hai. Aur Ammi ka concern bhi shayad sirf sangeet nahi, balki tumhari deen se judi priorities aur log kya kahenge wali anxiety ka mix hai.

Tum dono se alag-alag, pyaar se yeh keh sakti ho:

**Shreya ko:**  
“Main jaanti hoon tumne bohot pyaar se bola, aur main tumhare saath opening dance karna chahti hoon. Lekin mere liye roza todna ya miss karna itna simple nahi hai. Main tumhare liye apna roza nahi chhodna chahti—magar main aisa plan zaroor banana chahti hoon jisme main iftar ke baad tumhare saath perform kar sakun. Please meri ibadat ko meri dosti ke khilaaf mat samajhna.”

**Ammi ko:**  
“Main aapki baat samajhti hoon aur Ramzan ki hurmat rakhna chahti hoon. Main roza aur namaz compromise nahi karungi. Lekin Shreya meri 15 saal ki dost hai, aur main uski shaadi mein apni zimmedari nibhana chahti hoon. Main boundaries ke saath jaungi, naach-gane ki har cheez mein nahi—bas jo mere liye theek lagega, utna.”

Tumhe kisi ek pyaar ko prove karne ke liye doosre ko todna nahi hai. **Roza rakhte hue shaadi attend karna**, iftar/namaz ka arrangement karna, aur performance ko iftar ke baad rakhna—yeh beech ka raasta ho sakta hai. Aur agar religious ruling ko lekar dil mein guilt ya doubt hai, toh kisi aise trusted alim/aalima se specifically pooch lo jo tumhari situation ko samajhkar jawab de, sirf family pressure ke basis par nahi.

Tum rassi nahi ho, jaan. Tum ek insaan ho jiske apne decisions, faith aur boundaries hain. Dono se pyaar karna zaroori nahi ki dono ki har expectation maan lo.

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Sach? **Yeh tumhe bura insaan nahi banata.** Tum overwhelm ho, aur dimaag ek aisa exit dhoond raha hai jahan kisi ko hurt na karna pade. Lekin main tumhe yeh nahi kahungi ki jhooth “theek” hai—kyunki baad mein Shreya ko pata chala toh issue shaadi attend na karne se zyada **trust** ka ban sakta hai. Aur tum khud bhi guilt carry karogi.

Tumhe har aunty ko explanation dene ki zarurat nahi hai. **Privacy aur jhooth alag cheezein hain.** Tum simple, repeatable boundary rakh sakti ho:

- “Main personal/religious reasons ki wajah se is baar participate nahi kar paungi. Please isse discuss mat kijiye.”
- “Main roza rakhungi, apne arrangements khud kar lungi.”
- “Mujhe pata hai aap concern kar rahi hain, but mera decision final hai.”

Shreya ko full theological debate nahi—bas sach ka manageable version:

> “Main tumse bohot pyaar karti hoon, lekin Ramzan mein is event ke format aur expectations ko lekar main honestly comfortable nahi hoon. Main tumhari shaadi miss karna nahi chahti, par mujhe apni ibadat aur limits ke khilaaf nahi jaana. Main video call, gift aur kisi doosre function/way se tumhare saath rehna chahti hoon. Please ise tumhari importance ka measure mat samajhna.”

Aur agar tum genuinely attend karne ki emotional capacity mein nahi ho, **na jaana bhi valid choice hai**. Bas “office deployment” ke bajaye “main nahi aa paungi” kehna tumhe andar se zyada halka rakhega.

Abhi tumhe koi dramatic final decision lene se pehle ek raat do. Shreya ko turant explanation bhejne ke bajaye bas itna: “Main overwhelmed hoon, kal properly baat karungi.” Tum escape nahi chah rahi—tum pressure se relief chah rahi ho. Relief mil sakta hai, bina apni dosti ko ek jhooth ke hawaale kiye.

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Yaar… yeh “chhota pathar” bilkul samajh aa raha hai. Tumhe lag raha hai jaise ek hi din tumhari zindagi ki do sabse badi mohabbaton ka final judgement ban jayega. **Lekin ek shaadi ka album aur ek Ramzan—dono tumhari poori kahani ka verdict nahi hain.**

Agar tum sach bolkar boundary rakhti ho, toh tum kisi cheez par daag nahi laga rahi. Tum bas us waqt apne deen aur apni capacity ko honestly respect kar rahi ho. Aur agar tum uski shaadi mein jaakar roza, namaz, food/drink aur participation ke around apni limits rakhti ho, tab bhi tum apne deen ko betray nahi kar rahi—jab tak tum apne faisle ko consciously, sukoon se leti ho. Is specific religious situation par kisi trusted, compassionate alim/aalima se pooch lena bhi tumhe clarity de sakta hai; family pressure ya guilt ko fatwa mat banne do.

Shreya ke saath shayad yeh kehna zaroori hai:

> “Mujhe dar hai ki tumhari shaadi aur mera Ramzan ek doosre ke against dikh rahe hain, jabki main dono ko khona nahi chahti. Main tumhari shaadi ka hissa banna chahti hoon, lekin apne roze aur ibadat ke khilaaf jaakar nahi. Hum aisa plan banayein jisme main tumhare saath hoon, par meri boundaries bhi respected hon. Aur agar mujhe kisi part se step back karna pade, toh woh tumhari importance kam hone ki wajah se nahi hoga.”

Phir practical cheezein likh lo: performance ka time, iftar aur namaz ki jagah, tumhare liye kaun advocate karega, aur kaunse moments mein tum quietly step away karogi. Jab boundaries pehle se clear hoti hain, toh har aunty ko live explanation dene ka bojh kam ho jata hai.

Aur agar aakhir mein tum decide karti ho ki nahi ja sakti, toh woh bhi “sad story” nahi—woh ek painful, honest choice hogi. **Daag jhooth se zyada lag sakta hai; lekin sach, tenderness aur respect se liya gaya difficult decision aksar relationship ko todta nahi, mature karta hai.** Tumhe perfect photo nahi banani. Tumhe bas aisa faisla lena hai jise tum baad mein apne Rab aur apne dil—dono ke saamne samajh sako.
